text:
maya: FYI our android sample keeps freezing during large corpus sync when prefetch + adaptive throttler are enabled. It never errors, just huge lag and then sudden 429 wave. Anyone familiar with prefetch + cursor interactions?

jon: which SDK and mobile lib?

maya: go-sdk 1.4.0 used in an embedded mobile worker. Config snippet: 
```
throttle: {initialWindow: 100, maxInflight: 10, adaptive: true, growthStep: 3}
prefetch: {enabled: true, lookaheadPages: 2}
pagination: {cursor: true, eagerFetch: true}
```
Observed behavior: each successful page triggers two prefetches; inflight goes to max, queue expands, then token refreshs and some requests get resent. Logs: 
```
[2026-03-24T09:12:01Z] fetch page cursor=abc inflight=10 queued=48
[2026-03-24T09:12:02Z] upstream 429 model=redwood-medium
[2026-03-24T09:12:02Z] auth refresh start uid=mobile-worker-3
[2026-03-24T09:12:02Z] retry send id=pg-27 after refresh
[2026-03-24T09:12:03Z] duplicate send id=pg-27 (no refresh lock)
```

sam: sounds like two issues colliding: prefetch eagerness plus missing refresh-coalescing. Prefetch dominating inflight when growthStep=3 will double/triple requests per success.

lia: For mobile we recommend conservative defaults: initialWindow=40, maxInflight=6, growthStep=1, and prefetch.lookaheadPages=1. Also important: ensure the inflight counter is decremented synchronously before user callbacks that may queue prefetches.

maya: good call re: inflight-- before callbacks. I traced code: we emit 'page:success' then user callback triggers prefetch which increments inflight before original request fully cleaned up (we decrement in a finally but after callbacks).

jon: quick patch idea: swap cleanup order so internal bookkeeping happens before emitting events to app. Also add a small randomized delay before scheduling prefetch to avoid lockstep bursts: prefetchDelay = base + rand(0, jitterMs).

sam: another improvement: add a utility to help SDK users coordinate token refresh on mobile: `sdk.auth.withRefreshLock(fn)` which will run fn under a refresh promise. That prevents multiple parallel refresh flows in flaky network conditions.

maya: tried local changes: moved inflight decrement up and added prefetchDelay 50-150ms. Result: queue growth capped, much smoother. Still saw occasional duplicate sends during long tail token expiries.

lia: also ensure exponential backoff when receiving 429s for pagination endpoints. Mobile clients should backoff per-cursor rather than immediate retry of the same cursor.

sam: filed issue 'mobile-prefetch-cascade' and draft PR that: 1) decrements inflight before user events, 2) exposes prefetchDelay & growthStep on mobile defaults, 3) adds auth.withRefreshLock helper, 4) includes CursorRetryPolicy with jittered exponential backoff.

dev-bot: Created issue #4982 and draft PR #4991 (mobile-prefetch-cascade). CI: test coverage for cursor prefetch and auth lock added.

jon: can we add a small note to mobile quickstart: "Avoid eager prefetch with adaptive throttling; prefer lower growthStep and prefetchDelay on battery-constrained devices."

maya: will add doc blurb and update sample config. Thanks for the triage, team.

lia: leaving a sample config suggestion in the PR for mobile: `initialWindow=40,maxInflight=6,growthStep=1,prefetchDelay=100,lookaheadPages=1`.

maya: closing loop: after patch + config we no longer see freezing under our repro. Thread resolved for now.
